verdict.rationale: There's a documented bulk-upload workflow specifically for equity promises (grants), which directly supports batch issuance instead of one-at-a-time entry. However, evidence doesn't confirm bulk upload for historical transactions generally (e.g., past option exercises, cancellations, transfers) or provide details on file format/validation limits. Missing for 10: bulk upload/import for historical transaction types beyond promises, evidence of bulk editing of existing grants, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the feature's robustness.
